title: ORGANIC
scope: The ORGANIC row of the assigned Illumina poster: Occupied regions of genomes from affinity-purified naturally isolated chromatin. This is a single native-chromatin, MNase-digestion and affinity-enrichment route from cells to recovered DNA. Its left occupancy illustration is explanatory; adjacent X-ChIP, ATAC-Seq and clipped PAT-ChIP rows are contextual, not alternatives or additional targets of this card. Primary support is the poster-cited yeast remodeler native N-ChIP-seq implementation; this does not establish complete protocol equivalence for every native ChIP application. The schematic ends at DNA before library construction or sequencing.

operations.label: MNase digestion
operations.description: Digest DNA in the isolated native nuclear chromatin with micrococcal nuclease, changing the continuous chromatin substrate into digested material containing protein-protected DNA fragments.
operations.mechanism: Micrococcal nuclease digestion; the protected fragments remaining in native chromatin are the recoverable DNA substrate.
operations.information_effect: Produces fragment boundaries and lengths reflecting nuclease accessibility and protein protection under this preparation; digestion is not itself affinity selection for a particular target protein.

operations.label: Soluble extract
operations.description: Recover the soluble fraction from MNase-digested nuclear chromatin, producing dispersed, recoverable chromatin fragments for immunoprecipitation. The diagram leaves this extraction interface broad.
operations.information_effect: Retains DNA associated with proteins in the soluble recovered material. Insoluble or poorly recovered associations are not guaranteed to be represented.

evidence.rationale: The same list notes potentially poor solubilization of proteins and possible nuclei-isolation artifacts. Recovery and enrichment are selective, so the schematic does not establish an unbiased or exhaustive inventory of all in vivo contacts.

operations.label: Immunoprecipitate and DNA extraction
operations.description: Affinity-select chromatin through the depicted antibody and recover DNA from the selected material, replacing protein-associated chromatin particles with the DNA endpoint. Immunoprecipitation and DNA extraction remain one combined block as captioned.
operations.mechanism: Antibody-mediated immunoprecipitation followed by DNA recovery. The registered remodeler implementation captures FLAG-tagged remodelers and removes protein before recovering DNA; the generic drawing does not specify its own epitope.
operations.information_effect: Enriches DNA associated with the captured protein. The recovered DNA carries genomic positions and protected-fragment extents into a downstream sequencing library; it is the DNA, rather than the target protein, that is sequenced. Recovery supports mapping occupancy/association among retained fragments and does not establish perfect target specificity or exhaustive in vivo occupancy. Native associations must survive preparation to be recovered; MNase sequence bias and solubilization/nuclei-isolation effects can alter representation.

method_scopes.rationale: All four local operations belong to the named ORGANIC row, with no depicted branch or pooling. The nucleus and Isolated chromatin images are represented as one nuclear-chromatin preparation boundary: the primary source describes MNase treatment of nuclei followed by soluble extraction. The left yellow-highlighted occupancy drawing explains the intended biological readout and is not a reaction input. Antibody-shaped and orange symbols accompany selection and digestion, respectively; they are not independent material-transfer branches. MNase-Seq/native ChIP in the catalogue describes components, not separately assigned targets. The poster citation supports this native architecture under the paper's N-ChIP-seq name, without asserting a universal alias or equivalence of complete protocols.
